data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘h-m-r’, meaning 'to be fair, beautiful, and radiant'. In Islamic history, Humairaa is a name of a radiant, beautiful woman mentioned in the Hadith. The name Humairaa carries the meaning “Fair-skinned” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Humairaa usually hope their child will grow to embody fair-skinned and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The name Humairaa is mentioned in some Islamic sources as a name for women characterized by their beauty and rosy complexion.
